sentences.text:
It is the submission of the Appellant that open land belonging to the Appellant having House No.
457 total area 116 square meters, out of which, built up area 35.20 square meters situated at mouza Mokh, Tahsil Digras, District Yavatmal was acquired by the Respondents for submergence of Arunavati Project.

It is further stated that Notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 was issued on 4/3/1989.
The Land Acquisition Officer has passed the Award dated 26/3/1991 and granted compensation at the rate of Rs.14/- per square meter for open plot and Rs.440/- per square meter for constructed area.

3. The Appellant, being dissatisfied with the compensation awarded by the Land Acquisition Officer,
preferred the reference proceeding before the learned Reference Court.

In the reference proceeding,
the Appellant has examined the Valuer Thakurdas Boob (PW-2) at Exhibit-52.
In his evidence he deposed that he prepared the Valuation Report (Exhibit-53) and has determined the valuation of construction at the rate of Rs.1600/- per square meter and Rs.150/- for open plot.
As such, on the basis of this evidence on record, the Appellant was expecting the enhancement of the compensation as claimed in the reference proceeding.

According to the Appellant, without considering this specific evidence brought on record, the learned Reference Court has awarded meager compensation at the rate of Rs.26/- per square meter for open plot and Rs.600/- per square meter towards constructed area.
Hence, the present Appeal is preferred before this Court for enhancement of the compensation.
5. The learned Counsel for Respondent No. 4 vehemently opposed the Appeal.

It is his contention that the evidence produced on record by the Appellant was not upto the satisfaction to conclude that Appellant is entitled for higher compensation as claimed by the Appellant in the matter.

According to him, compensation awarded by the learned Reference Court is just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, and therefore, no indulgence of this Court is required in the matter.

6. In support of his submission, Appellant has relied upon the Judgment delivered by this Court in First Appeal No.167/2018 (Bhausaheb Balabhau Wankhade (dead) through L.Rs. V/s The State of Maharashtra & Ors.).

entities.text: L.Rs. V/s The State of Maharashtra & Ors.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said Appeal was also arising out of the same acquisition proceeding of the village Mokh, Tahsil Digras, District Yavatmal.

This Court, after considering the relevant decision of the Co-ordinate Bench and the factual aspects involved in the matter, held that the Claimant therein are entitled for 4/5 9-B.Judg.fa.362.2018.odt the compensation at the rate of Rs.100/- per square meter towards open plot and Rs.1000/- per square meter towards constructed area.

7. In the background of abovesaid factual position, as this Court has already taken a view in identical matter arising out of the same acquisition proceeding, I do not think it necessary to take any other view.
According to me, the Judgment delivered in First Appeal No.167/2018 is squarely applicable to the facts and circumstances of the present case.
Hence, I proceed to pass following order.

1. The First Appeal is allowed.

2. The Judgment and Order dated 8/8/2012 passed by the learned Civil Judge Senior Division,
Darwha, District Yavatmal in Land Acquisition Case No. 127/1995 (New LAC No.637/2004) is hereby modified to the extent that the Appellant is entitled for compensation at the rate of Rs.100/-
per square meter towards open land and Rs.1000/- per square meter towards constructed area of the property of the Appellant, which is acquired in the matter.
